info.biography: 吴文帝孙和之女，母为张妃，吴末帝孙皓的嫡妹。建兴二年，太傅诸葛恪被诛并被灭三族，孙和张妃双双自杀。孙氏自幼父母双亡。后来由孙皓的生母何姬抚养长大。永安七年八月初三，孙皓被拥立为帝，并追封九月追谥父亲孙和为文皇帝。孙氏因此也抬为公主。不久经由孙皓的安排做主下，下嫁于表兄陆抗的次子陆景为妻。
info.characteristic: 可获得或弃置其他角色的牌；拥有直伤与多刀能力。

spells.o: 出牌阶段开始时，你可获得一名其他角色区域内一张牌，然后若你在其攻击范围内，其可对你使用一张【杀】，若你不在其攻击范围内，本轮你与其均视为在对方的攻击范围内。
spells.w: 选择一张<font color='#FFD800'>杀</font>对{0}使用或取消
spells.v: 请选择一名角色，获得其区域内的一张牌或点取消

spells.o: 每回合各限一次，当你造成或受到伤害后，你可弃置受伤角色X+1张牌对伤害来源造成一点伤害（X为受伤角色已损失体力值且不足则全弃）。然后你获得其中的【杀】且你使用这些【杀】无次数限制。
spells.v: 是否发动此技能弃置{0}{1}张牌对{2}造成一点伤害

guides.level: same-product author guide, not an official FAQ
guides.author: Meng Zui Liang Yuan, republished by Da Qiao
guides.qualification: Test-period article; only unchanged clauses corroborated by current primary are used. It is not formal-release proof.
observations: Saying takes Hand/Equipment/Judgment and measures range after the take.
Real Wusheng/Longdan Slash sources are legitimate; natural physical Slash alone does not cover the request.
Dongxin dealt/received directions each have one opportunity, and real recursive retorts finish before the original Slash reclaim.
Insufficient HE means discarding all available primary cards.

guides.level: same-product current author guide, not an official FAQ
guides.author: Fei Yu Miao, republished by Da Qiao
observations: Confirms March 14 formal release and the current pair of skills.

currentPublicClientUiEvidence.localRead: Existing bundle archive was opened read-only and the member inspected in memory; no importer or raw-copy creation.

observations.supports: Saying source regions NORMAL | EQUIP | DECIDE, target cannot be self; an add/remove effect updates the selected character's DATA_SAYING state.
Dongxin selector NORMAL | EQUIP, not Judgment; required display count is current damaged character MaxHp-Hp plus configured extension.
Only an actual Slash card object whose exact CardId is in DATA_DONGXIN.Targets obtains the use permission; this is not a global Slash-limit modifier.
The role update carries actual target entity IDs and adds Dongxin card tags. This client does not reveal server departure/reacquisition expiry or grant revocation rules.

implementationInferences.rule: An accepted activation with required=min(lostHp+1,actualHE)=0 is successful zero-cost issuance. It still retorts and reclaims as applicable, but creates no logical-discard invoice.
implementationInferences.authority: Explicit implementation interpretation; no dedicated same-product FAQ found.

implementationInferences.rule: A source-less damage does not offer unpaid Dongxin. After payment, an original source that dies or disappears is not replaced: skip that damage and continue reclaiming the original eligible materials.
implementationInferences.authority: Explicit implementation interpretation of original source and ordered clauses.

implementationInferences.rule: At accepted selection freeze the actual damaged role and lost HP; pay the complete min(X+1,HE) set. Reclaim only entities that were actual effective Slash-family cards at their last known paid Hand identity, not optional view-as possibilities, and remain at the original exact Discard entry. Printed material kind remains separately frozen.
implementationInferences.authority: Native entity/continuous identity contract combined with the current wording; not a dedicated official ruling.

implementationInferences.rule: A reclaimed card is bound to its original recipient and precise physical ID. No turn or departure expiry is invented. Real departure facts remain recorded; the original recipient may regain that exact entity and retain quota rights. Another holder does not inherit them.
implementationInferences.authority: Root-adopted owner/entity interpretation where current text provides no termination; client exact-ID tags corroborate entity specificity, not the lifetime inference.

implementationInferences.rule: Only true Use by the bound recipient of one currently held exact marked entity gains Slash-count exemption. It does not provide distance, immunity/prohibition bypass, multi-material, unrelated provider or zero-material permission. An accepted use freezes its issued right through native source/actor changes; no other user is granted a new right.
implementationInferences.authority: Combination of the owner-bound text with native accepted-use origin rules; not an exclusive FAQ.

implementationInferences.rule: Drain the real take and all equipment/HP/movement/skill children, then measure the former holder attack range. Outside range grants symmetric attack-range membership until genuine round change, without changing combat distance. Inside range creates an optional native requested Slash under normal live target/distance/prohibitions, countsTowardSlashLimit=false.
implementationInferences.authority: Guide confirms post-take measurement; exact child timing, quota and native continuation interpretation are explicit.

implementationInferences.rule: Use one accepted paid issuance per owner/skill/direction/actualTurn, independent of source instances. Per-damage is not per-point. Self damage can satisfy the remaining opposite direction; scalar issuance before native damage bounds recursive retorts.
implementationInferences.authority: Current per-turn-each wording plus same-product recursion observation.

implementationInferences.rule: Unpaid selection requires a live source. Once the original movement or zero-cost issuance is paid, loss of the skill does not repay or revoke it. Native damage, Lion recovery, Ox grain spill, discarded-material claims and supplier payment subtrees finish through their true parent. Dead users receive no new cards or new Slash menu.

implementation.owningState: ProgramSkillFrame.SunYuan; CardUseFrame.SayingSlash/DongxinUse; immutable nested collections; scalar rule events. No parallel pending sidecar.
implementation.validationStatus: Complete native runtime; centralized focused behavior, shared mechanisms, bounded routine and visual gallery checks passed in the fixed ordinary-mode scope.

verification.validationScope: Fixed ordinary-mode source verification. In copied sources only, the unfinished Hulao weapon-recast entry is disabled and five Hulao cards are excluded from public ImplementedCards while enum definitions remain. Concurrent main-workspace changes and Boss/Hulao as a whole are not accepted.
